E-BCD.D_SCI_fortlogs.name: Business Impact Analysis
E-BCD.D_SCI_fortlogs.description: A criticality assessment (CA) is completed to identify mission critical processes. Subsequently, a business impact analysis (BIA) is documented for mission critical processes to determine resource requirements for resiliency. The CA and BIA are reviewed and approved.

E-BCD.E_SCI_fortlogs.name: Process Continuity
E-BCD.E_SCI_fortlogs.description: In accordance with the Business Continuity Management Security Standard, a Process Continuity Plan (PCP) is documented and maintained for each mission critical business process – providing procedures for sustaining operations while recovering from a significant disruption. The plan is reviewed, approved and communicated to all named stakeholders.

E-BCD.F_SCI_fortlogs.name: Process Continuity
E-BCD.F_SCI_fortlogs.description: The Process Continuity Plan is tested and in accordance with the Business Continuity Management Security Standard to demonstrate ability to sustain business operations during a disruption.

E-BCD.J_SCI_fortlogs.name: Business Impact Analysis
E-BCD.J_SCI_fortlogs.description: A criticality assessment (CA) is completed to identify mission critical products. Subsequently, a business impact analysis (BIA) is documented for mission critical products to determine resource requirements for resiliency. The CA and BIA are reviewed and approved.

E-CM01_SCI_fortlogs.name: Risk Assessment
E-CM01_SCI_fortlogs.description: All changes require a risk assessment to be performed prior to submitting the change ticket. This risk assessment is based on the information provided in the Change ticket and the results are documented within the ticket.

E-CM02_SCI_fortlogs.name: Validate & Document Change Results
E-CM02_SCI_fortlogs.description: For all Normal, Emergency and Standard changes, the Change Requestor validates the implemented change and documents the result within the Change ticket.

E-CM03_SCI_fortlogs.name: Get Change Ticket Confirmation
E-CM03_SCI_fortlogs.description: The change requestor/implementor confirms the ticket state as “closed” and close code by selecting the appropriate closure status.

E-CM05_BTP_SCI_fortlogs.name: Approval of Changes
E-CM05_BTP_SCI_fortlogs.description: All changes are approved based on the type of change prior to deployment/submission by defined approvers. Change requestor and approver are different persons.

E-SA04_SCI_fortlogs.name: Vulnerabilities evaluation and follow-up
